wars.what_happened: One shared server where every player is in the same universe.
Player-owned stations and then sovereignty let alliances formally hold space.
The first region-wide war; Phoenix fell apart from inside and it ended in a ceasefire.
wars.scale: 150 vs 100 ships in one battle, when 20 a side was normal

wars.what_happened: A forum community that recruited and taught beginners when other alliances turned them away.
Dreadnoughts, carriers and Titans made war depend on a large player-run industry.
wars.scale: One Titan cost about 70bn ISK, about US$6,000 in 2005

wars.event: Band of Brothers takes Fountain and Delve
wars.sides: Band of Brothers vs Fountain Alliance
wars.what_happened: A surprise attack while still allied; a spy removed the fuel from the defenders' bases.
wars.scale: Fountain fell from 2,500 to under 600 members

wars.sides: Coalition of the South vs Red Alliance
wars.what_happened: About 70 Russian pilots held off a 400-ship fleet for days; the legend drew thousands of new players.
The two outcast alliances agreed in a pub to cover each other's time zones.
Built in secret; the developer had to create it by hand because the game wasn't ready.

wars.sides: Band of Brothers vs Ascendant Frontier
wars.what_happened: The first Titan was destroyed; the leader quit and the alliance collapsed within weeks.
wars.scale: Band of Brothers' bloc then held 561 systems

wars.event: T20 scandal starts the Great War
wars.sides: Band of Brothers vs the community
wars.what_happened: A developer was found giving items to Band of Brothers, uniting its enemies.
Band of Brothers' advance south stopped.

wars.sides: RedSwarm, Northern Coalition, Pandemic Legion vs Band of Brothers
wars.what_happened: Fighting ran around the clock for over a week; Band of Brothers held but shrank.
wars.scale: 400-1,200 pilots in one system; Band of Brothers fell from 14 regions to 3

wars.event: Band of Brothers disbanded by a spy
wars.what_happened: A director who had defected took the alliance's assets and shut it down; it made world news.
wars.scale: 15 dreadnoughts and hundreds of ships taken

wars.event: Fall of Delve ends the Great War
wars.sides: Goonswarm, Pandemic Legion, Northern Coalition vs KenZoku
wars.what_happened: The defenders' fleet was trapped and their money ran out.
wars.scale: 30,000+ of about 300,000 players took part; 1,000+ ships in one fight

wars.what_happened: Each system now needs a hub and a monthly bill, so missing a payment can cost an empire.
wars.source: Groen, Empires of Eve Vol. 2, ch. Dominion

wars.event: Goonswarm loses everything to its own leader
wars.what_happened: A missed bill cost the alliance its space, then its leader expelled everyone and took the treasury.
Outsiders got a place to learn the game, free starter ships and ship replacement; it grew past 3,000 members.
wars.source: Groen, Vol. 2, chs. North and South; A Couch in Deklein

wars.what_happened: An unpopular expansion and a $70 virtual monocle led to mass in-game protests.
wars.scale: About 8% of subscribers lost; 20% of CCP staff laid off
wars.source: Groen, Vol. 2, ch. The Summer of Rage

wars.what_happened: A mass attack on everyone leaving the main market hub, in policed space.

wars.sides: CFC vs Pandemic Legion, TEST and others
wars.what_happened: A misclick sent one Titan alone into a small fight; it grew into a huge battle near the starter areas, streamed live.
The largest battle to date ended TEST's hold on Fountain.
wars.scale: 4,000+ players; about 2,900 ships destroyed; 10,000 watching on Twitch
wars.source: Groen, Vol. 2, ch. The Battle of 6VDT-H

wars.sides: CFC and Russians vs N3 and Pandemic Legion
wars.what_happened: A missed territory payment exposed a staging system; the battle lasted about 21 hours.
wars.scale: About 7,548 players; N3 and Pandemic Legion lost 59 Titans; over US$300,000 equivalent
wars.source: Groen, Vol. 2, chs. The Bloodbath; Imperium

wars.what_happened: After 15 months on top, the winning coalition renamed itself The Imperium.
The Korean publisher bought EVE's developer.
